messages:
nina choi: Vendor requested a 48h pen test. We need: final RBAC mapping, KMS grant flow, audit export steps, and retest acceptance criteria. Can we list owners and minimal deliverables?

omar el-badry: Ill take RBAC. Plan: create an assume-role 'pt_assessor_<date>' with explicit ARNs for inference APIs + model storage. No List* permissions. Short session (20m).

pete keller: KMS: create grant constrained by EncryptionContext {purpose:pen-test}, retire after 96h. Provide presigned upload for evidence with SSE-KMS. Will add CLI snippet to PR.

sre-oncall: Deploys paused for window. Also will enable cross-account copy of CloudTrail to locked bucket.

nina choi: Retest criteria: remediation merged + staging deploy + reproduction doc + cloudtrail export showing no exploit artifacts. Also require unit/regression test where possible.

pen-test-bot: Created ticket https://go/internal/pen-tests/1777770000 and checklist items.

omar el-badry: Action items: RBAC policy + trust doc. pete: KMS grant + presigned flow. nina: vendor liaison + change-freeze note. ETA EOD Tue. If blockers, update ticket.
